## Field

Three campaign areas. Theme copy is on [Projects](projects.html).

**Temperate rainforest geoecology.** Yellow-cedar decline plots on west Chichagof Island, Tongass National Forest (Sheet’ká Kwáan territory). 2026 eddy-covariance at S Douglas fen near Juneau (CSAT+7200; USFS). Jessica Murray and Aaron MacDonald.

**Native and urban Chicagoland.** Nachusa Grasslands (Dixon, IL); UIC James Woodworth Prairie (JWP); Chicago CROCUS urban soils; Urban Growers Collective / PRL urban-agriculture GHG plots; Green Era Campus.

**AI for natural methane.** FLUXNET-CH4 / UpCH4 synthesis; ATMOS / AmeriFlux site US-AMS (eddy-covariance methane; QA/QC passed 2026); ESIIL AI for Natural Methane working group.

## Papers

Selected publications from the [UIC EaES faculty profile](https://eaes.uic.edu/profiles/mcnicol-gavin/), grouped to match Projects. First-author pillars include the UpCH4 upscaling (2023), the North Pacific rainforest soil-carbon map (2019), the *Nature Climate Change* sanitation study (2020), and the restored-wetland flux paper (2017). 2026 papers with DOIs are listed with the matching theme. ## Data

- **UpCH4 v1.0** — monthly gridded freshwater wetland CH4, 2001–2018. ORNL DAAC [10.3334/ORNLDAAC/2253](https://doi.org/10.3334/ORNLDAAC/2253). Also listed on [NASA Open Data](https://data.nasa.gov/dataset/global-wetland-methane-emissions-derived-from-fluxnet-and-the-upch4-model-2001-2018-c7437).
- **FLUXNET-CH4** — global multi-ecosystem methane flux dataset ([Delwiche et al. 2021](https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-13-3607-2021)).
- **ISRaD** — International Soil Radiocarbon Database v1.0 ([Lawrence et al. 2020](https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-12-61-2020)).
- **AI4NM** — [CyVerse dataset](https://dc.cyverse.org/dataset/ai_for_natural_methane_harmonizing_natural_methane_datasets_using_knowledge_guided_machine_learning) for the ESIIL working group (parent NSF 2153040).
- **AmeriFlux US-AMS** — half-hourly gap-filled methane/energy fluxes (QA/QC passed 2026).
- **Nachusa microbes** — NCBI BioSample accessions beginning `SAMN61436570` (2026).
